steps.u: Our Playwright checkout test fails about one run in five on CI but passes locally. Stabilise it.

steps.r: await page.click('#pay'); await page.waitForTimeout(2000); expect(await page.textContent('.status')).toBe('Paid')

steps.a: The fixed two second sleep is the flake: on a slow CI runner the payment mock sometimes takes longer. The test should wait for the condition instead of the clock.

reference.summary: Stabilised a flaky Playwright checkout test by replacing a fixed two second sleep with an auto-retrying assertion on the status text and a role-based locator; twenty repeated runs passed.
facts: flaky checkout end to end test on CI

decisions.choice: wait on the status text instead of a fixed sleep
decisions.reason: a slow CI runner sometimes takes longer than the sleep
